      "entity": "Transfer of the uniform load to structured-grid degrees of freedom",

        "Integrate a uniform line load or traction to obtain consistent nodal forces, including reduced weights at footprint boundaries.",

      "effect": "layout"

    {

      "description": "Secs. 4.3 and 5.4 do not identify passive-region masks, including support pads, loading pads, or an outer skin.",

        "Every element inside the beam envelope is designable.",
        "Keep one-element-thick solid pads at the supports and beneath the load.",
        "Keep a one-element-thick solid outer skin and solid contact pads; optimize the interior."

      "effect": "layout"

    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Absolute stiffness scale of the base material",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 introduces the base elastic tensor C* but supplies no numerical modulus; Sec. 5.4 supplies no base-material stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize the reference Young's modulus to 1 in consistent units.",
        "Use a reference Young's modulus of 1000 in the same units, scaling the entire elastic tensor uniformly."

      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Base-material elastic ratios and constitutive symmetry",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 does not provide Poisson's ratio, shear moduli, numerical tensor components, or an explicit isotropy assumption for C*.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic base material with Poisson's ratio 0.2.",
        "Isotropic base material with Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Orthotropic base material with E_L/E_W = 2, E_H/E_W = 1, independent Poisson ratios 0.2, and shear moduli 0.4E_W, enforcing reciprocal Poisson ratios."

      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-dependent homogenized elastic tensors for the two beam runs",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 specifies the exponential form in Eq. (26), but gives no fitted a1 and a2 values for either Table 2 unit used in Sec. 5.4. Neither unit's tensor-versus-density data are supplied. A conventional SIMP default would therefore be an additional modeling choice.",

        "Use the scalar special case C^H(rho) = [(exp(2rho) - 1)/(exp(2) - 1)] C*.",
        "Use the scalar special case C^H(rho) = [(exp(4rho) - 1)/(exp(4) - 1)] C*.",
        "Use separate exponential fits for the independent tensor components, producing a density-dependent orthotropic response."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Orientation of the homogenized porous material within the beam",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.4 identifies symmetric porous units but does not align their material axes with the beam axes. Sec. 4.3 permits nine independent elastic coefficients, so symmetry does not establish isotropy.",
      "readings": [
        "Align unit u, v, and w axes with beam length, width, and height.",
        "Align unit w, v, and u axes with beam length, width, and height.",
        "Rotate the unit axes 45 degrees about the beam-height axis."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Allowable relative-density interval",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (27) introduces rho_min and rho_max, but Sec. 5.4 gives neither value.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min = 0.001 and rho_max = 1.",
        "rho_min = 0.1 and rho_max = 0.8.",
        "rho_min = 0.2 and rho_max = 0.6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Macroscopic density-field B-spline basis and smoothing scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 does not specify density-field degrees, control-grid dimensions N_u × N_v × N_w, or knot vectors. The numerical B-spline settings in Secs. 5.1 and 5.3 concern unit fitting, not this beam density field.",
      "readings": [
        "Trilinear B-splines with open uniform knots at every analysis-grid plane.",
        "Tricubic B-splines with open uniform knots spaced two analysis elements apart in each direction.",
        "Tricubic B-splines with open uniform knots spaced four analysis elements apart in each direction."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Additional density or sensitivity filtering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 attributes smoothness to the B-spline density field but does not explicitly specify whether additional filtering is used, or its radius and boundary treatment.",
      "readings": [
        "Use B-spline smoothing alone, with no additional filter.",
        "Add a normalized cone density filter of radius 1.5 element widths, truncated at the domain boundary.",
        "Add a sensitivity filter of radius 3 element widths."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Beam analysis-grid resolution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.4 gives no analysis element counts or element sizes. The manufactured dimensions and the voxel/control-grid counts in other subsections do not determine the beam mesh.",
      "readings": [
        "60 × 24 × 24 elements along length, width, and height.",
        "120 × 48 × 48 elements along length, width, and height.",
        "240 × 96 × 96 elements along length, width, and height."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Displacement approximation order and continuity",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 explicitly uses IGA but does not give displacement-basis degrees or interior knot multiplicities for the beam.",
      "readings": [
        "Degree-one tensor-product IGA with C0 continuity, equivalent on an affine box to trilinear eight-node hexahedra.",
        "Degree-two tensor-product IGA with C1 interior continuity.",
        "Degree-three tensor-product IGA with C2 interior continuity."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Stiffness integration and density sampling",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (27) gives a stiffness integral but no quadrature rule or rule for sampling the varying density within an analysis element.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 2 × 2 × 2 Gauss points per element and evaluate density at each point.",
        "Use 3 × 3 × 3 Gauss points per element and evaluate density at each point.",
        "Freeze density at the element-center value and use 2 × 2 × 2 Gauss integration for the stiffness."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Macroscopic design-symmetry restrictions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The symmetry requirements in Secs. 4 and 5.4 concern the porous units. The text does not say whether the beam density field is constrained to be symmetric.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimize the full beam with independent density variables and no imposed macroscopic symmetry.",
        "Impose reflection symmetry about the beam's width-midplane.",
        "Impose reflection symmetry about both the longitudinal midspan plane and width-midplane."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimality Criteria update parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 specifies OC but gives no move limit, damping exponent, or volume-multiplier search tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Absolute density move limit 0.2, damping exponent 0.5, and relative multiplier-search tolerance 0.001.",
        "Absolute density move limit 0.05, damping exponent 0.5, and relative multiplier-search tolerance 0.000001."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Compliance-optimization stopping rule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.3 and 5.4 give no convergence threshold or iteration cap for OC. The L < 0 stopping rule in Sec. 4.2 applies to unit connectivity optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.01, with a cap of 200 iterations.",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.001, with a cap of 1000 iterations.",
        "Stop after relative compliance change stays below 0.0001 for ten iterations, with a cap of 500 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Equilibrium-solve method and accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.3 states KU = F but does not specify the numerical linear solver or its convergence tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a sparse direct factorization.",
        "Use preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 0.00000001.",
        "Use preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 0.0001."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
